criteria.name: B60-1  the near arm clears its own measured floor
criteria.detail: the within-state arm sits at levels 1.77x, monthly_changes 1.54x of its own shifted-placebo floor

criteria.name: B60-2  premise: no broadcast reaches the far end of this carrier
criteria.premise_source: Agmarknet publishes every market's daily price nationally, and it is the source of this data; and lentil is among the five pulses under a centrally announced support price, set before the sowing season on the costs commission's recommendation.

withdrawn_form.was: strong form: the far arm sits at its floor
withdrawn_form.why: scored the registration with its antecedent removed
withdrawn_form.cell: every far cell above its floor

criteria.detail: the premise does not hold on this carrier, so the registered conditional-independence prediction has no object here and the far arm's level is reported rather than scored. Far cells at levels 1.75x, monthly_changes 1.35x of their own floors (every far cell above its floor), which on a carrier with broadcast is the branch the registration names rather than a reading against it

criteria.name: B60-3  graded form: the residual is smaller between distant regions
criteria.detail: 1 of 1 readings have near above far, monthly_changes: near 1.54x far 1.35x. Not read, because the sign flips across the declared knob grid and a cell a knob can turn over is not a reading: levels (near 1.77x far 1.75x at the default point, 4 of 9 grid points put near above far)

criteria.name: B60-4  WITHDRAWN: scored an account that is not the rival

grid_note.B: cells where the far arm falls to its floor, so the framework reads the zero it registered and the rival does not
grid_note.C: cells where the far arm stays above its floor, so the rival's prediction holds and the framework's does not
grid_note.why: both sentences are what this criterion would have said while it was typed as a rival's prediction; it was withdrawn, so neither cell is claimed

criteria.rival_premise: Spatial arbitrage in a connected trading network: two markets trading one good are held together by traders moving the good between them directly, so their prices differ by transport cost alone.
criteria.rival_entailment: A direct bilateral link is not routed through any third market, so conditioning on a third market does not remove it and the partial correlation of two distant markets stays above what the same statistic returns on shifted series.
criteria.withdrawn: spatial arbitrage is this framework's own projection operator, not an opposing account of where a level comes from
criteria.detail: withdrawn. Reading kept: the rival's prediction holds in every far cell. 2 of 2 far cells stay above the floor (levels 1.75x, monthly_changes 1.35x)

criteria.name: B60-5  the triple count is reported as presentation, not as evidence
criteria.detail: 168 far triples come from 8 states and 228 near triples from 38 districts. Triples sharing a series are not independent, so no count in this record is an independent-observation count
